raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-PER-ArequipaColca",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "GORE Arequipa PIU lacks prior experience implementing World Bank-financed operations, leading to potential implementation, fiduciary, and E&S compliance delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted capacity building and training in World Bank procedures supported by GFPP funds, and appoint experienced key staff within 60 days of effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "GORE has experience implementing regional infrastructure projects... It does not have experience implementing WB-financed projects"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Fragmented institutional responsibilities across line ministries and subnational levels may cause coordination failures and investment delays.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish high-level Steering and Consultative Committees and execute Interinstitutional Agreements across participating entities.",
      "evidence": "Efficient budgeting and implementation of investments in tourism are hindered by lack of coordination within a highly fragmented institutional landscape"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Extreme climate hazards, including flooding and landslides, threaten road connectivity and access to isolated tourism destinations.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate climate resilience specifications into road designs, including slope stabilization, oversized culverts, and improved drainage infrastructure.",
      "evidence": "floods and resulting mudslides weaken transportation infrastructure, road closures impede access to tourism destinations"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Delays in recruiting qualified Financial Management staff for the PIU may hinder early financial operations and disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare terms of reference in advance and ensure all FM positions are filled within two months of effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "Delayed recruitment of FM staff."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Subnational budget allocation and execution delays in initial project phases may slow down overall project implementation.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "GORE Arequipa will initiate budget allocation processes for external and counterpart funds immediately upon loan signing.",
      "evidence": "In Peru, initial project implementation phases often experience delays in budget allocation and low budget execution rates"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Inadequate familiarity with Bank financial management standards could lead to errors in accounting and financial reporting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize the national SIAF system supplemented by annual independent audits and clear procedures outlined in the POM.",
      "evidence": "Inadequate experience with Bank-financed projects may result in errors in financial records and reporting."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "High road traffic mortality rates along regional corridors pose safety hazards for both local populations and tourists.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate comprehensive road safety features such as guardrails, road markings, speed calming measures, and road safety audits.",
      "evidence": "Arequipa recorded 11.7 road traffic deaths per 100,000 people, a significantly higher rate than Peru's national average"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Lack of adequate long-term maintenance arrangements could undermine the durability and performance of upgraded infrastructure.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish formal maintenance mechanisms, local capacity strengthening, and clear institutional handoff arrangements prior to completion.",
      "evidence": "the project will support arrangements that ensure mechanisms are in place for the ongoing maintenance and sustainability of the improved assets."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Seismic activity and extreme weather threaten fragile 17th–19th century historic churches and cultural heritage sites.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Perform structural reinforcement using traditional techniques, integrate storm drainage, and implement preventive risk management manuals.",
      "evidence": "The churches were built in the 17th to 19th centuries and are in various states of disrepair, many having suffered earthquake damage."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Risks of sexual harassment, exploitation, and gender wage gaps impede women's economic participation in local tourism activities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a dedicated SEA/SH Action Plan alongside targeted capacity building for female entrepreneurs and women's associations.",
      "evidence": "exposure to sexual harassment and exploitation risks, and knowledge gap about basic opportunities and skills"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Failure to sign required Interinstitutional Agreements with participating municipalities blocks disbursement for Component 1 and 2 works.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize early inter-agency negotiations and set up standard templates to execute agreements rapidly following project start.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawals shall be made for Goods, works... until and unless the Bank has received at least three signed Interinstitutional Agreements"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "High labor informality in the region complicates reliable monitoring and measurement of project-generated direct and indirect jobs.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy remote sensing methodologies, satellite imagery, AI algorithms, and disaggregated ENAHO survey data to track labor impacts.",
      "evidence": "Measuring the impact of project interventions on jobs is difficult considering the high level of informality"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Risk of counterpart funding shortfalls or delays from MINCETUR, jeopardizing total project financing.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Covenant counterpart funding obligations in the Loan Agreement and sign a binding Cooperation Agreement between MINCETUR and GORE.",
      "evidence": "MINCETUR shall be responsible for the Counterpart Funds and the oversight of the Project"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Deficient water and sanitation facilities present public health hazards and restrict outdoor adventure tourism activities.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade potable water systems, sewage networks, and wastewater treatment plants across key corridor municipalities.",
      "evidence": "Poor water and sanitation facilities also create a health hazard for communities and tourists and limits adventure tourism activities"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Forest fires and unsustainable agricultural practices threaten high-Andean forest ecosystems (Bosque de Queñua).",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement reforestation across 174 hectares, construct water retention systems, and train local communities in fire control and sustainable grazing.",
      "evidence": "prevention of illegal activities, prevention and control of forest fires, and tourism promotion."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Inadequate baseline data on visitor profiles and expenditures hinders effective regional tourism marketing and planning.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a regional tourism observatory and information system to systematically collect, analyze, and publish visitor data.",
      "evidence": "there is currently a lack of data on Arequipa visitor profiles, length of stay, visitor spending"
    }
  ]
}
